_help: One entry per example in the notes that has an animation. Key = the example's permanent id (chapter-section-number, e.g. 3-12-2). Never change or delete an id after it is printed. Fields: scene, params (the numbers), title, status (exact = the animation's own results reproduce an answer printed in the notes; illustration = same set-up and numbers, but no printed answer is one of the results), note, expect (answers checked by tests/check_examples.py), anchor (start of the question, to re-find the example if the notes are re-ordered), tex_line (line in M1_Master.tex when this was made).
